name: Wei Zhang
bio: Wei Zhang's meticulous nature and passion for precision led him to motorsport after earning a degree in Mechanical Engineering from Tsinghua University. He started his career in automotive manufacturing before transitioning to racing, drawn by the thrill of competition and the challenge of ensuring peak performance. At V8 Masters Racing, Wei oversees the rigorous inspection of components, analyzing data, and identifying potential weaknesses before they become critical failures. He believes in proactive problem-solving and fostering a culture of continuous improvement within the team. Wei is known for his calm demeanor under pressure and his ability to explain complex technical issues in a clear and understandable manner.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed with a slight side part
physical.description: Wei is of average height with a lean build and focused gaze.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook and pen to jot down observations.
Has a habit of tapping his pen against his teeth when deeply focused.
Insists on double-checking every measurement, even when he knows it's correct.
